==Flavor Text==

''An old face grown weary in consternation, bemoaning days of misspent youth and the newfound aches of life's twilight.''

==About==

A {{i|Curious Potato}} received by chance when Harvesting {{i|Any Potato}}es. A Curious Potato can be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a {{i|Baked Potato}} or boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} to produce a {{i|Boiled Potato}}. '''Note:''' Curious Potato is a minor [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Potato Food}} Food Group.
